The merge gate's browser tests load the worktree, not the live site
add.why: Template.test.mjs:7 and TasksPage.test.mjs default to http://monorepo.localhost; merge.mjs runs them as covering tests without passing the worktree's url, so they test michael/dev instead of the branch, and they timed out once while the live site was busy (qf-5's merge, 2026-10-23 22:28: 'navigating to http://monorepo.localhost/framework/core/Page/Template/' TimeoutError; both passed on re-run). Pass the worktree's base (from .worktrees.json) as argv[2] for tests that take a site, in merge.mjs's test runner.
